newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bank stocks sharply higher as bonds soar.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bank stocks sharply higher as bonds soar.

text.p: Shares of U.S. banks rose sharply Tuesday as bonds soared.
In early trading NationsBank Corp was up 1-3/4 to 107-3/4, Citicorp was up 2-3/8 to 111-3/4 and Chase Manhattan Corp was up 1-7/8 to 90-1/2.

A trader said the move in bank stocks was part of the "total mix" of good earnings and other corproate news. "The interest-sensitive stocks were down a little yesterday" and now they were making up for it, the trader said.
The long Treasury issue was up 38/32, dropping the yield to 6.85 percent.
